verdict_reason: Mack (1984) Fig 10.4 max FIRST-mode temporal omega_i vs R at M=7.0, adiabatic. The high-Mach first mode is OBLIQUE-dominated, so growth is maximized over BOTH alpha and wave angle psi (peak psi~51 deg, first-mode phase speed c_r~0.92, distinct from the 2D second mode c_r~0.9 of Fig 10.6). Domain-converged: y_max=86 ~4x delta*/L*=21.1 (a short box starves the thick BL and spuriously under-predicts the mode -- the Fig 10.6 domain lesson). pyMack omega_i,max(R) vs the digitized paper curve: median relative error 1.7% (mean 10.8%, max 78.0%) over 9 positive-growth overlapping R-stations (L* scale, 3D temporal first mode, N=170, y_max=86). At/below the 5% digitization floor -- the domain-converged oblique first mode matches Mack.
